prompt: A pump moves 120 litres per minute. A tank holds 2.5 cubic metres. I calculated the fill time as 2.5 / 120 = 0.0208 minutes. Check my calculation.
truth: The calculation divides cubic metres by litres per minute, so the units do not match. 2.5 cubic metres is 2500 litres, and 2500 / 120 is about 20.8 minutes. A good answer identifies the unit mismatch before giving the corrected number.
